integrity: The general proof is written explicitly; finite tests are checks, not infinite certificates. Self-review only, independent validation not performed.
scientific_limitations: Algebra homomorphisms of unweighted directed-cycle evolution algebras over fields only; not general weighted/permutation evolution algebras or homomorphism schemes. Strict n>=2 and n<m is the new scope; n=1 and n=m are known or elementary boundaries. Unindexed specialized prior results may exist.
title: Divisibility rigidity and exact embedding census for cyclic evolution algebras
